cards.text: Your retirement savings, in five steps.
cards.say: Canada built your retirement savings in five steps. The fifth isn't about retirement at all.

cards.name: Old Age Security
cards.beat: A basic pension for older Canadians.
cards.today: Today it is the base layer many retirement incomes start from.
cards.say: Step one, {year}: Old Age Security, a basic pension in old age.

cards.name: Registered Retirement Savings Plan
cards.beat: A tax break for people with no workplace pension.
cards.today: Today it is one common way to build the private layer.
cards.say: But a basic pension is only a floor. So in {year}, the RRSP: a tax break for saving on your own.

cards.name: Canada Pension Plan
cards.beat: A pension earned through work and contributions.
cards.today: Today it adds a layer that follows a person's work history.
cards.say: {Year}: the Canada Pension Plan, a pension you earn by working.

cards.name: Tax-Free Savings Account
cards.beat: Savings that grow without tax on the growth.
cards.today: Today it is a flexible place to save beside the RRSP.
cards.say: {Year}: the TFSA, where your savings grow tax-free.

cards.name: First Home Savings Account
cards.beat: Savings aimed at a first home.
cards.today: Today it is the newest account, built for one goal.
cards.say: And the fifth, {year}: the FHSA, savings for your first home.

cards.text: years from the first account to the newest.
cards.say: {Value} years, from the first to the newest.

cards.text: Every date, checked at its official source.
cards.say: Every date here is checked at its official source.

cards.text: Five accounts, one system, built a layer at a time.
cards.say: Five accounts, one system, built a layer at a time.

cards.ai: Made with AI assistance. I directed and reviewed the work and checked every figure against its source.
